fields.Name: T152 - User-Menu Items
fields.Description: Opens the top-right user avatar menu, then exercises its items (theme toggle light/dark, About dialog, and finally Sign Out) in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Sign Out runs last because it ends the session. Consolidates old T373, T376, T380.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Click the user avatar button in the TOP-RIGHT corner of the header to open the user menu. Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) theme-toggle — find the theme toggle row in the user menu (a sun/moon switch with a label like 'Theme' or 'Dark Mode') and click it to flip the theme, confirming the entire application visibly re-skins (light interface switches to a dark background with light text, or vice-versa) and the toggle reflects the new state, then click it again to flip back; (2) about-dialog — reopen the user menu if needed, confirm it shows a header with your user name/email plus menu items, then click the 'About' item and confirm an About dialog opens showing MemberJunction information such as a version number (you do NOT need to do anything inside the dialog — close it); (3) sign-out — reopen the user menu and click the 'Sign Out' (logout) item, confirming the app tears down the session and returns to the sign-in / login screen (an auth prompt or login button appears); you do NOT need to log back in. Do sign-out LAST, since it ends the session. Keep going until all sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: theme-toggle
checkpoints.instruction: flip the theme light/dark from the user menu
visualCriteria: The user avatar menu opens and shows a theme toggle control (sun/moon switch), clicking it visibly changes the app's color scheme (light<->dark) across the header and page background, and the toggle switch position/icon updates to reflect the newly applied theme

checkpoints.name: about-dialog
checkpoints.instruction: open the About dialog from the user menu
visualCriteria: The user avatar menu displays a user identity header (name and/or email) plus menu items including an 'About' item, and clicking 'About' opens a dialog with MemberJunction/version information

checkpoints.name: sign-out
checkpoints.instruction: sign out and land on the login screen
visualCriteria: Clicking the 'Sign Out' / logout item leaves the authenticated Explorer shell (header/tabs no longer shown) and presents a login / sign-in screen or auth prompt
